notes.title: New Content / Patch Dec 10th
notes.notes:
Tutorial Experience


 Added a the tutorial level designed to welcome new players
 Introduces core gameplay mechanics in an interactive learning environment
 Helps players learn basic concepts before tackling main gameplay


Combat & AI Improvements
Fighter Unit Behavior


 Fixed a critical pathfinding issue where fighters would incorrectly return to previous attack locations after executing regular move commands
 Resolved a targeting system bug that prevented fighters from properly engaging all elements of Raider Camps
 These fixes significantly improve combat reliability and unit responsiveness


Known Issues
We are actively monitoring and addressing any issues that arise. Please report any bugs or unusual behavior through our Discord channel.

Join our community on Discord to:


 Report bugs and technical issues
 Submit feature requests and suggestions
 Connect with other players
 Stay updated on future developments


You can find it here: Discord

notes.title: Patch Notes Dec 7th
notes.notes:
Major System Improvements


 Complete rebuild of the upgrade interface to better match game theme
 Comprehensive rebalancing of core systems including upkeep, resource generation, and cost structures


New Features


 Introduced new Enemy Base game mode
[olist]
 Bases dynamically build up over time
 Enemies now spawn from established bases rather than waves
 Customizable difficulty settings instead of progression-based scaling
[/olist]

 Enemy statistics now properly save and load between sessions


Gameplay Updates


 Incresed grace period timer to 5 minutes for more dynamic gameplay
 Implemented 5-minute Upkeep reduction of 25%
 Added new strategic upgrade options


Join our community on Discord to report bugs, submit feature requests, and connect with other players: Discord

notes.title: New Patch Available
notes.notes:
Major System Improvements


 Core system optimizations resulting in significant FPS improvements
 Completely overhauled enemy base code with improved movement, detection, and targeting systems
 Re-implemented upkeep system and global statistics tracking
 Enhanced raycasting for more reliable UI interactions and fixed dead spots in clickable elements


Combat & Enemy Updates


 Fixed bugs in enemy statistics - defeat and victory screens now display accurate information
 Added missing enemy animations
 Improved NPC event system
 Fixed point application system
 Increased enemy spawn rates per cycle
 Enhanced boss enemy spawn rates for populations above 20




Bug Fixes & Technical Updates


 Resolved UI interaction issues across the game screen
 Fixed point calculation and distribution in the NPC event system
 Re-enabled previously disabled features including statistics page and upkeep system


Known Issues


 Enemy Statistics currently not saved/loaded. 


We continue to monitor game performance and balance. Please report any issues through our usual channels.
